name: codex-relay
description: Rust native Codex relay with a React account console

scripts.check: pnpm check:rust && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm check:web
scripts.check:quick:web: pnpm test:web-workers && pnpm check:format:web && pnpm typecheck
scripts.check:rust: pnpm test:build-memory && cargo fmt --check && node scripts/cargo-with-memory.mjs clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo-with-memory.mjs test --locked --no-fail-fast
scripts.check:web: pnpm test:web-workers && pnpm check:format:web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:web && pnpm test:web
scripts.format:web: prettier --write "web/src/{api,AccountDetails,AccountScheduling,Statistics,UsageRankings,AccountImport,AccountCredentialExport,accountBackup}.{ts,tsx}" web/contracts web/tests/api-contract.spec.ts web/tests/account-transfer.spec.ts web/src/account-transfer.css scripts/test-admin-contracts.mjs
scripts.check:format:web: prettier --check "web/src/{api,AccountDetails,AccountScheduling,Statistics,UsageRankings,AccountImport,AccountCredentialExport,accountBackup}.{ts,tsx}" web/contracts web/tests/api-contract.spec.ts web/tests/account-transfer.spec.ts web/src/account-transfer.css scripts/test-admin-contracts.mjs
